properties.evidence: The served hub skill, section 1, says of a local hub "one connection per child design in the session's MCP configuration. That configuration is the list." The code says otherwise: upstream.rs ("Why the child list is the manifest") reads the hub's declared dependencies as its child list, and dec:until-designs-share-a-server-the-cross-design-check-runs-at-the-hub searches "every design it tracks". So under --call the skill points an agent at a list that does not exist and away from one that does.
